## PR description
### [Doc] Update README and installation docs for v0.26.0  [labels: documentation]
## Purpose

Update the README and installation documentation for the [v0.26.0 release](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-omni/releases/tag/v0.26.0):

- announce v0.26.0 and summarize its major user-facing improvements
- highlight MiniCPM-o 4.5 and MiniMax H3 in the supported-model examples
- list full-duplex realtime serving last in the flexible/easy-to-use feature list and mark it as experimental
- consolidate the v0.14.0 through v0.22.0 announcements into the stable even-minor release cadence aligned with upstream vLLM
- remove the vllm-omni-skills news entry
- document the vLLM-Omni 0.26.x ↔ vLLM 0.26.x compatibility requirement
- align the CUDA base image, NPU source dependencies, and upstream configuration link with the 0.26 release line

## Test Plan

**vLLM Version:** 0.26.0

**vLLM-Omni Commit:** `765caa2a121aec024201936c4decb1151225991c`

- Run repository pre-commit hooks on all six changed documentation files.
- Build the MkDocs site in strict mode against the latest upstream `main`.
- Inspect the rendered landing, installation, GPU, NPU, and configuration pages.
- Verify the referenced vLLM and vLLM-Ascend release refs upstream.
- Confirm the MUSA and quickstart changes requested for removal in review are absent from the final PR diff.

## Test Result

- Pre-commit hooks: passed.
- Strict MkDocs build: passed.
- Render inspection: the release summary, model names, parenthetical experimental full-duplex entry, compatibility note, installation pins, and configuration link render correctly.
- Review feedback: the MUSA and quickstart files are unchanged from upstream `main`.
- Upstream refs verified: vLLM `v0.26.0` and vLLM-Ascend `releases/v0.26.0rc`.
